claim: Within one shot, view changes from profile through frontal to opposite profile. Arrows are manual heuristic axes, not calibrated motion.
Automatic broad rider-head ROI gives3/8purple; same classifier on posthoc manually tight crops gives8/8purple. Same purplehorse only; no11classaccuracy.
Two new-frame nearest/gated errors; globaluniqueassignment resolves these under manual landmarks. References not user reviewed.
Both testedVLMs localize a nonleader horse at34s under current prompt; image output is raw normalized coordinates mapped tosource.
Even mirror-consistent0.1sflow plus simple screen projection disagrees with provisional leader on3/8frames. Not a validated ground-motion/rank estimator.
Histogram/MADcutcandidates require verification; one candidate is an exposure/colour shift rather than a camera cut.
Compositeviews and floatingidentitylabels exist in source; these timestamps were excluded, not erased generatively.
